items.text: Just please improve stability, interface and add some QOL updates.
items.text_zh: 只是请改善稳定性、界面，并添加一些生活质量更新。

items.text: I don't mind the fact that I literally couldn't figure out how to open a door in the first 20 minutes and I ended up repairing a fridge for days on end. What did bother me was the fact that the spritework is horrible. I cannot tell anything apart. I have played hundreds of hours of SS13 and other pixelized games that are probably even smaller than this game especially with the way Byond engine works (tiny ass window) and I still understand intuitively what I'm generally looking at. This game needs a heavy overhaul in visual design. UI is not very nice to look at also.
items.text_zh: 我不介意我一开始的20分钟里完全搞不懂怎么开门，最后连续好几天都在修冰箱。真正让我烦的是，像素美术糟糕透顶。我什么都分不清。我玩过几百小时的SS13以及其他像素化游戏，那些游戏的像素可能比这个游戏还小，尤其是考虑到Byond引擎的运作方式（小得可怜的窗口），我仍然能凭直觉大致明白自己在看什么。这个游戏需要在视觉设计上进行大幅 overhaul。UI 看起来也不太舒服。

observations.evidence: UI is not very nice to look at also
